query:
SELECT id AS "id: PlaylistId"
           FROM playlists
           WHERE room_id = $1
             AND creator_id = $2
             AND deleted_at IS NULL
             AND (
                 parent_id IS NULL
                 OR parent_id NOT IN (
                     SELECT id
                     FROM playlists
                     WHERE room_id = $1
                       AND creator_id = $2
                       AND deleted_at IS NULL
                 )
             )
           ORDER BY id
